about_the_game:
Kegan is a dark fantasy action RPG that follows the journey of a skilled dual-blade warrior driven by vengeance, loss, and the weight of a legacy he never chose. After witnessing the destruction of his village and the death of his father—once the king of Valengard—Kegan sets out to uncover the truth behind the mysterious artifact known as the Heart of Eternity, and to destroy the cult that seeks to unleash its deadly power.

Explore a richly detailed medieval world filled with danger, political intrigue, and ancient magic. From cursed forests to forgotten ruins, every corner of the world holds secrets, enemies, and allies. Engage in fast-paced, visceral combat that blends precision, agility, and brutal swordplay using Kegan’s signature dual-blade technique.

Form bonds with unforgettable characters, face morally complex choices, and carve your own path through a world on the brink of shadow. Will you become a beacon of hope—or embrace the darkness to destroy it from within?

Embrace your destiny. Face your past. And fight for a future worth saving.
